invariants.rationale: IOUtils.runMerge returns an Iterator, so result should not be null in normal cases.
instantTime is used as a parameter for getUpdateHandle and IOUtils.runMerge, so it should be non-null.
fileId is a parameter to getUpdateHandle and IOUtils.runMerge, likely required to be non-null.
keyToNewRecords is passed into getUpdateHandle, assumed to be required.
oldDataFile is required for getUpdateHandle in this method.
